split: existing P3B seed0 400 TRAIN fit / 100 TRAIN probe
coverage: 3D normalized VAD 8th-neighbor radius; threshold=75th percentile of 400 fit leave-one-out radii; sparse if probe radius > threshold
constants: per-dimension mean and median of 400 fit TRAIN original-scale labels only
skill: 1 - region MAE_model / region MAE_constant, per dimension and macro
extremity: mean per-dimension absolute distance from 400-fit median; quartile cutoffs from 400 fit only
verdict: SUPPORTED only if sparse macro skill is lower than dense with bootstrap upper 95% bound below zero for both constants and an extremity-adjusted excess-error gap persists; NOT_SUPPORTED if both baseline-relative gaps are nonnegative without evidence of sparse disadvantage; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
adjusted_contrast: OLS sample macro excess error (model minus constant) on intercept + sparse indicator + mean absolute distance from 400-fit median; stratified sample bootstrap 10000, same seed stream; persistence requires sparse coefficient 95% lower bound > 0 for both constants
